_comment: ESM: the workspace packages (@repo/shared-types) and several Nest 11 add-ons ship ESM-only, so the API is ESM too. Relative imports therefore carry an explicit .js extension. Alias paths are declared in apps/api/tsconfig.json, not here — `baseUrl` resolves relative to the file that declares it. Canonical alias table: docs/rules/01-typescript.md A2.
